criteria: Given a signed-in user, When they open any module, Then the active module shows a highlight and bold text
Then the application routes to the reports view within 200ms without a full page reload
Then keyboard focus rings are visible and Enter navigates to the module
Given a mobile screen width below 768 pixels, Then the bar is collapsed by default into a hamburger menu

failure_modes.title: Race condition on rapid double-clicking
failure_modes.effect: Two modules render at once and the highlight lands on the wrong one
failure_modes.cause: The route change and the highlight update are not ordered
failure_modes.test_idea: Click two modules within 100 ms and check which one is highlighted

cases.title: The bar collapses into a hamburger below 768 px
cases.pre_conditions: A signed-in user on the Aurora Storefront dashboard
steps: Set the viewport width to 767 px
cases.expected_result: The navigation bar is collapsed into a hamburger menu

cases.title: The hamburger menu opens every module link
cases.pre_conditions: A signed-in user on a 390 px viewport
steps: Check every module link is listed
cases.expected_result: Every module in the sidebar is reachable from the menu
